autumns.line: Nor the snow shoe light or the autumns
stanza: Nor the snow shoe light or the autumns
Threw the meaning out the door

autumns.line: Gold and silver burned my Autumns
stanza: Gold and silver burned my Autumns
All too soon they'd fade and die
And then, ah there were no others
Milk and honey were their lies
